_note: Exercise library (D30). work = seconds per round (gym: estimated time per set); reps shown for gym. Templates are recommended sessions built from library ids; item fields override the exercise defaults.

exercises.name: Jog + dynamic leg swings
exercises.how: Easy jog, then leg swings front/side, walking lunges with a twist. Keep it relaxed.
exercises.mistake: Rushing the warm-up at full speed
exercises.fix: Start easy, build up, stop if anything pinches

exercises.name: Hip openers + glute activation
exercises.how: 90/90 hip switches, glute bridges, lateral band-free side steps. Hip and knee insurance.
exercises.mistake: Rushing the warm-up at full speed
exercises.fix: Start easy, build up, stop if anything pinches

exercises.name: Build-up sprints (no ball)
exercises.how: 10-15 m at 70%, 80%, 90%. Stop if you feel sharp knee pain.
exercises.mistake: Going flat out on the first rep
exercises.fix: Build up: 70%, then 80%, then 90%

exercises.name: Juggling
exercises.how: Round 1 stronger foot, round 2 weaker foot, round 3 both feet + thighs. Count your best streak.
exercises.fix: Soft touches, ball always within a stride

exercises.name: Sprint + change of direction (no ball)
exercises.how: Sprint 10 m to a marker, plant hard, cut 45-90 degrees, accelerate 5 m. Alternate the cutting foot.
exercises.fix: Plant the outside foot hard and push off it

exercises.name: Tight-space close control
exercises.how: Stay inside a 3x3 m square. Soles, inside/outside touches, quick turns. Head up.
exercises.fix: Head up between touches, glance down only to check

exercises.name: Dribble + change direction
exercises.how: Drive the ball between markers: cut, drag-back, step-over. Explode out of every turn. Use your weaker foot on rounds 2 and 4.
exercises.mistake: Slowing down to do the move
exercises.fix: Do the move at speed, then explode out of it

exercises.name: Freestyle dribbling
exercises.how: Free play with the ball: feints, rolls, step-overs, whatever you want to own. Try one new move each round.
exercises.fix: Head up between touches, glance down only to check

exercises.name: 1v1 reaction (voice cues)
exercises.how: Attack a marker as the defender. When you hear LEFT or RIGHT, the defender is committing that way: go the other way and accelerate past.
exercises.fix: React to the cue, don't guess

exercises.name: 1v1 then finish
exercises.how: Same cue game, but finish with a shot after you beat the marker. Alternate feet.
exercises.fix: Wait for the defender to commit, then go the other way

exercises.name: Cool-down: hips, quads, hamstrings, IT band
exercises.how: Hip flexor stretch, quad stretch, hamstring stretch, figure-4 glute stretch, 60 s each side. Breathe slowly.
exercises.fix: Ease in, hold still and breathe

exercises.name: Wall passes: ground, both feet
exercises.how: 2-3 m from the wall. Round 1 right, 2 left, 3 alternate, 4 one-touch alternate. Pass firm, control with the first touch.
exercises.mistake: Stabbing at the ball with a stiff foot
exercises.fix: Soft ankle, cushion it, open your body to the pass

exercises.name: Wall passes: in the air
exercises.how: Throw or volley the ball at the wall and control the rebound out of the air: thigh, instep, chest. Weaker foot on rounds 2 and 4.
exercises.mistake: Watching the ball hit your foot
exercises.fix: Eyes on the ball, soft body part to kill the speed

exercises.name: Weak foot: receive and pass
exercises.how: Pass off the wall with your weaker foot only, receive with it only. Slow and accurate beats fast and sloppy.
exercises.fix: Stay on the weaker foot, slow and accurate first

exercises.name: Shooting: stationary
exercises.how: Set the ball, strike low and across the keeper. Alternate right and left. Plant foot next to the ball, head over it.
exercises.mistake: Planting too far from the ball, shot sails over
exercises.fix: Plant beside the ball, knee over it, follow through low

exercises.name: Shooting: on the move
exercises.how: Dribble 5-8 m, take one touch to set, shoot. Weaker foot on rounds 2 and 4.
exercises.mistake: Taking a heavy first touch before the shot
exercises.fix: One quick touch to set it, then strike

exercises.name: Crossing and passing
exercises.how: Run along the wing, cross or pass to a target. Alternate lofted and driven. Both feet.
exercises.mistake: Rushing it, ball hits the first defender
exercises.fix: Take the touch, look up, then drive or loft it to the target

exercises.name: Ground passing: one touch
exercises.how: 5-8 m apart, firm pass on the ground. Round 1 stronger foot, 2 weaker foot, 3 alternate, 4 move side to side.
exercises.mistake: Stabbing at the ball with a stiff foot
exercises.fix: Soft ankle, cushion it, open your body to the pass

exercises.name: Ground passing: two touch
exercises.how: First touch sets the ball to the side, second touch passes. Open up your body to the pass.
exercises.mistake: Stabbing at the ball with a stiff foot
exercises.fix: Soft ankle, cushion it, open your body to the pass

exercises.name: Air control: one touch back
exercises.how: Partner tosses or lofts the ball. Control or volley it straight back. Thigh, instep, chest. Alternate feet.
exercises.mistake: Watching the ball hit your foot
exercises.fix: Eyes on the ball, soft body part to kill the speed

exercises.name: Passing while moving
exercises.how: Pass and move along a line, one touch. Keep the pace up, call for the ball.
exercises.mistake: Stabbing at the ball with a stiff foot
exercises.fix: Soft ankle, cushion it, open your body to the pass

exercises.name: 1v1 with partner
exercises.how: Real defender. Attacker tries to beat him and finish or cross. Swap roles each round.
exercises.fix: Wait for the defender to commit, then go the other way

exercises.name: Cool-down
exercises.how: Hip flexor, quad, hamstring, glute stretch, 45 s each side.
exercises.fix: Ease in, hold still and breathe

exercises.name: Foam roll quads and glutes
exercises.how: Slow passes, pause on tight spots for 20-30 s. Roll the outer thigh lightly, not hard on the IT band.
exercises.fix: Slow passes, pause 20-30 s on a tight spot

exercises.name: 90/90 hip switches
exercises.how: Sit tall, rotate both knees side to side with control.
exercises.fix: Slow and controlled, feel it in the hip

exercises.name: Couch stretch (hip flexor/quad)
exercises.how: Rear knee on a mat, foot up on the wall or bench. Squeeze the glute. Each side.
exercises.fix: Ease in, hold still and breathe

exercises.name: Hamstring stretch
exercises.how: Lying leg raise with a strap or towel. Each side.
exercises.fix: Ease in, hold still and breathe

exercises.name: Glute bridge
exercises.how: Drive through the heels, pause 2 s at the top.

exercises.name: Side-lying leg raise / clamshell
exercises.how: Slow and controlled. Each side. Feel the outer hip, not the lower back.
exercises.mistake: Letting the hip or knee drift
exercises.fix: Keep the pelvis still, feel it in the outer hip

exercises.name: Figure-4 glute stretch
exercises.how: Lying down, ankle over opposite knee. Each side.
exercises.fix: Ease in, hold still and breathe

exercises.name: Toe taps
exercises.how: Tap the top of the ball with alternate soles, light and fast on the balls of your feet.
exercises.fix: Head up between touches, glance down only to check

exercises.name: Sole rolls, both feet
exercises.how: Roll the ball across your body with the sole, switch feet each time. Weaker foot leads on even rounds.
exercises.fix: Soft touches, ball always within a stride

exercises.name: Inside-outside touches
exercises.how: Inside then outside of the same foot, moving forward. Round 2 weaker foot only.
exercises.fix: Soft touches, ball always within a stride

exercises.name: Cone weave dribble
exercises.how: Weave through 5-6 markers a stride apart, every touch close. Back through with the weaker foot only.
exercises.fix: Head up between touches, glance down only to check

exercises.name: Skill moves at speed
exercises.how: Drive at a marker, beat it with one move (step-over, scissors, drag-back, croqueta), accelerate 5 m. One move per round.
exercises.mistake: Rushing the move with a loose ball
exercises.fix: Slow and clean first, then speed it up

exercises.name: Receive on the half-turn
exercises.how: Play off a wall, open your body and take the first touch across you into space, then drive. Alternate sides.
exercises.mistake: Turning with the ball in the way
exercises.fix: Open your hips and take the touch across your body

exercises.name: Scan, receive and turn
exercises.how: Before each pass comes back off the wall, check over both shoulders, then turn away from an imagined defender.
exercises.mistake: Turning with the ball in the way
exercises.fix: Open your hips and take the touch across your body

exercises.name: Aerial control: self toss
exercises.how: Toss the ball high, kill it dead with foot, thigh or chest. Every third one with the weaker foot.
exercises.mistake: Watching the ball hit your foot
exercises.fix: Eyes on the ball, soft body part to kill the speed

exercises.name: Long passing to a target
exercises.how: Strike 25-35 m diagonals at a target. Plant foot beside the ball, lock the ankle. Half with your weak foot.
exercises.fix: Plant the foot beside the ball, lock the ankle, strike the middle

exercises.name: Weak-foot finishing
exercises.how: Shots with your weaker foot only: set it, then strike low across the goal. Accuracy before power.
exercises.fix: Stay on the weaker foot, slow and accurate first

exercises.name: Volleys from a self feed
exercises.how: Toss the ball up, let it drop, volley at the target. Keep your knee over the ball.
exercises.mistake: Leaning back, ball goes over the bar
exercises.fix: Knee over the ball, strike through the top half

exercises.name: Cut inside and finish
exercises.how: From the wing, cut inside onto your stronger foot and finish far post. Alternate wings.
exercises.fix: Pick a corner and strike low across the goal

exercises.name: Defensive jockey footwork
exercises.how: Side-on stance, short quick steps, backpedal and shuffle between markers. On LEFT or RIGHT, turn and sprint 5 m that way.
exercises.fix: Short quick steps, never cross, stay low and side-on

exercises.name: Acceleration starts (5-10 m)
exercises.how: From a standing, side-on or backwards start, explode for 5-10 m. Full recovery, every rep at max speed.
exercises.fix: Stay low and drive the knees for the first steps

exercises.name: Lateral shuffle + sprint
exercises.how: Shuffle 3 m left, 3 m right, then sprint 10 m forward. Stay low through the shuffle.
exercises.fix: Plant the outside foot hard and push off it

exercises.name: Repeated sprints
exercises.how: 30 m sprints with short rest: match-like repeat-sprint ability. Stop if your speed drops off a lot.
exercises.mistake: Slowing down in the later reps
exercises.fix: Stop the set when your speed drops

exercises.name: Box-to-box runs
exercises.how: Run about 70 m at 80% pace, walk back. Builds the engine for 90 minutes.
exercises.fix: Hold a steady pace the whole way

exercises.name: Ball-at-feet intervals
exercises.how: Dribble at a high tempo around a large square, keep the ball close the whole time.
exercises.fix: Hold a steady pace the whole way

exercises.name: Back squat
exercises.how: Heavy but clean: 2 reps left in the tank. Drive up fast, as explosive as you can on every rep. Small plates under the heels help you sit deeper.
exercises.safe: Brace before every rep and keep the bar over the middle of your feet. Knees follow the toes; stop the set if your lower back rounds at the bottom.

exercises.name: Goblet squat
exercises.how: One dumbbell held up at your chest, elbows in. Sit down between your hips, chest up, then drive up fast.

exercises.name: Trap bar deadlift
exercises.how: Push the floor away, stand up fast. Keep your back flat.
exercises.safe: Stand in the middle of the bar, flat back, push through the whole foot. Lock out with your glutes, not by leaning back.

exercises.name: Bulgarian split squat
exercises.how: Rear foot on a bench, front knee at 90 degrees at the bottom and tracking over the toes, back straight with a slight forward lean. Hip and knee stability for cutting.
exercises.safe: Front foot far enough forward that the knee stays over the toes; back foot just rests on the bench.

exercises.name: Dumbbell split squat
exercises.how: Dumbbells at your sides, feet staggered. Lower until the back knee nearly touches, drive up through the front foot.

exercises.name: Dumbbell curtsy lunge
exercises.how: Dumbbells at your sides. Step back on a diagonal behind the front leg, sink, then drive back up through the front foot.
exercises.fix: Knee over the middle toe, torso tall

exercises.name: Romanian deadlift
exercises.how: Hinge back with soft knees and a straight back until you feel it down the back of the legs. Controlled down, explosive up.
exercises.safe: Soft knees, push the hips back and keep the bar on your legs. Stop when your back starts to round, usually just below the knees.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Romanian deadlift
exercises.how: Dumbbells in front of the thighs, soft knees. Push the hips back, dumbbells close to the legs, feel the hamstrings, stand up strong.
exercises.safe: Dumbbells close to your legs, hips back, flat back. Stop when your back starts to round.

exercises.name: Dumbbell deadlift
exercises.how: Dumbbells by your feet, flat back. Push the floor away and stand tall, dumbbells close to your legs.
exercises.safe: Dumbbells beside your feet, flat back, push the floor away. Don't let the weights drift forward.

exercises.name: Dumbbell hip thrust
exercises.how: Shoulders on a bench, a heavy dumbbell on your hips. Drive the hips up, squeeze the glutes at the top for a second.

exercises.name: Nordic hamstring curl
exercises.how: Kneel with heels anchored, lower yourself as slowly as you can. Big hamstring-injury protector.
exercises.safe: Start with a few slow reps and catch yourself with your hands. Big jumps in Nordic volume cause the soreness you're trying to prevent.

exercises.name: Single-leg calf raise
exercises.how: Full range, pause at the top. Ankles and Achilles for sprinting.
exercises.fix: Pause at the top, slow all the way down

exercises.name: Bench press
exercises.how: Shoulder blades pinned, feet planted, bar to mid-chest.
exercises.safe: Shoulder blades squeezed back, feet planted, elbows about 45 degrees. Lower to the lower chest with control, and use a spotter or safety pins when it's heavy.

exercises.name: Dumbbell bench press
exercises.how: On a flat bench, dumbbells over the chest. Lower to the sides of the chest, press up and slightly in.
exercises.safe: Shoulder blades back, elbows about 45 degrees. Bring the dumbbells to your chest with control, never bounce.

exercises.name: Incline dumbbell press
exercises.how: Bench at 30-45 degrees, dumbbells at the upper chest. Press up and slightly in, lower slowly to the sides of the chest.
exercises.safe: Bench at about 30–45 degrees, shoulder blades back, elbows under the dumbbells.
exercises.fix: Elbows about 45 degrees, wrists stacked over elbows

exercises.name: Pull-ups
exercises.how: Full hang to chin over the bar. Add weight when 8 feels easy.
exercises.safe: Full hang at the bottom, shoulders down before you pull. No kipping or swinging.

exercises.name: Dumbbell overhead press
exercises.how: Ribs down, press straight up, no leaning back.
exercises.safe: Ribs down and glutes tight; press up without leaning back. Elbows a little in front of the body.

exercises.name: Barbell overhead press
exercises.how: Bar on the front of the shoulders, glutes tight. Press straight up and push the head through at the top. No leaning back.
exercises.safe: Squeeze your glutes and keep the ribs down so the lower back doesn't arch. Head through at the top.

exercises.name: Bent-over row
exercises.how: Flat back, pull to the belly, squeeze the shoulder blades.
exercises.safe: Flat back at about 45 degrees, knees soft. Pull to the lower ribs without jerking the torso up.

exercises.name: Dumbbell bent-over row
exercises.how: Hinge forward with a flat back, dumbbells hanging. Pull them to your hips, squeeze the shoulder blades, lower slowly.

exercises.name: Landmine row (T-bar)
exercises.how: Straddle the bar facing away from the corner, flat back, knees soft. Pull the end to your chest, squeeze the shoulder blades, lower slowly.
needs: landmine or barbell in a corner
exercises.fix: Flat back, shoulders down, pull the elbows back

exercises.name: Seated cable row
exercises.how: Sit tall, chest up. Pull the handle to your belly and squeeze the shoulder blades. Don't lean back to move the weight.
exercises.fix: Flat back, shoulders down, pull the elbows back

exercises.name: Face pull
exercises.how: Rope at face height. Pull to your eyes with the elbows high and wide, squeeze the upper back. Keeps shoulders healthy.
exercises.fix: Flat back, shoulders down, pull the elbows back

exercises.name: Push-ups
exercises.how: Body in one straight line, chest to a fist from the floor.

exercises.name: Box jump
exercises.how: Jump up explosively, land soft and quiet, step down. Quality over height.
exercises.safe: Pick a box you land on easily, land soft with knees out, and step down; don't jump down.

exercises.name: Broad jump
exercises.how: Swing the arms, jump as far as you can, stick the landing.

exercises.name: Single-leg bounds
exercises.how: Bound forward on one leg, push hard off the ground. First-step power.
exercises.fix: Push hard off the ground and drive forward

exercises.name: Med ball rotational throw
exercises.how: Side-on to a wall, rotate from the hips and throw hard. Shooting and turning power.
exercises.fix: Power from the hips: turn and throw through the ball

exercises.name: Kettlebell swing
exercises.how: Snap the hips, let the bell float to chest height. Hinge, not squat.
exercises.safe: It's a hinge, not a squat: hips back, flat back, snap the hips. The arms only guide the bell.

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.how: Elbows under shoulders, squeeze glutes, no sagging. Harder: a plate on your back.

exercises.name: Copenhagen plank
exercises.how: Top leg on a bench, lift the hips into a straight line. Groin-injury protector for footballers. New to it? Start with the short lever (knee on the bench) and move up when the hold is solid.
exercises.safe: Start with the knee on the bench (short lever) before the foot. Stop if you feel a sharp pain in the groin.
exercises.fix: Squeeze the glutes, one line from head to heels

exercises.name: Pallof press
exercises.how: Cable or band at chest height, press out and resist the twist.

exercises.name: Hanging leg raise
exercises.how: Hang from a bar, ribs down. Raise the legs to hip height or higher without swinging, lower slowly. Bent knees make it easier.
exercises.fix: Ribs down, lift with the abs, lower slowly

exercises.name: Dead bug
exercises.how: Lower back pressed into the floor, opposite arm and leg reach slowly. Harder: hold a plate over your chest.

exercises.name: Bike intervals
exercises.how: 30 seconds all-out on the bike, easy spin in the rest.
exercises.fix: Full effort for the whole interval

exercises.name: Sled push
exercises.how: Low body angle, drive the knees. Acceleration strength.
exercises.safe: Arms long, flat back, drive with short steps. Pick a weight you can keep moving.
exercises.fix: Low body angle, push through the whole foot

exercises.name: Gym warm-up: bike + mobility
exercises.how: 5 min easy bike or row, then leg swings, hip openers and a few bodyweight squats.
exercises.mistake: Rushing the warm-up at full speed
exercises.fix: Start easy, build up, stop if anything pinches

exercises.name: Gym cool-down: stretch
exercises.how: Hip flexors, hamstrings, glutes, chest. Slow breathing.
exercises.fix: Ease in, hold still and breathe

exercises.name: Power clean
exercises.how: Bar from the floor, explode with the hips, catch high in a quarter squat. Speed, not grind.
exercises.safe: Learn it light. Bar close, back flat, the hips do the work and the arms only guide. Catch with elbows high and knees bent; never catch with straight legs.
exercises.fix: Extend the hips first, the arms finish last

exercises.name: Hang clean
exercises.how: Start at mid-thigh, jump and shrug, fast elbows. Easier to learn than the full clean.
exercises.safe: Start from above the knee with a flat back. Jump and shrug, then catch soft with elbows high. Light weights until it's clean.
exercises.fix: Extend the hips first, the arms finish last

exercises.name: Dumbbell hang clean
exercises.how: Dumbbells at mid-thigh. Jump and shrug, pull them up and catch them on your shoulders in a quarter squat. Fast elbows.
exercises.safe: Dumbbells at your sides, hips drive, catch on the shoulders with soft knees. Don't curl them up.
exercises.fix: Extend the hips first, the arms finish last

exercises.name: Push jerk
exercises.how: Short dip, drive with the legs, punch the bar overhead and catch in a slight bend.
exercises.safe: Dip straight down, not forward, then drive. Lock the bar over the back of your head with ribs down.
exercises.fix: Extend the hips first, the arms finish last

exercises.name: Dumbbell push press
exercises.how: Dumbbells at your shoulders. Short dip, drive with the legs and press them overhead in one move.
exercises.safe: Short dip straight down, drive with the legs, then press. Don't arch back to finish.

exercises.name: Split jerk
exercises.how: Dip and drive, split the feet front and back to catch. Alternate the front foot each set.
exercises.safe: Dip straight down, split fast with the front shin vertical, and lock out over your head. Go light while learning the split.
exercises.fix: Extend the hips first, the arms finish last

exercises.name: Hang snatch
exercises.how: Wide grip from mid-thigh, extend fully, pull under and catch overhead. Light weight, perfect positions.
exercises.safe: The most technical lift: light weights, wide grip, bar close. Catch with locked arms; if you lose it, let it fall forward and step back.
exercises.fix: Extend the hips first, the arms finish last

exercises.name: Single-arm dumbbell snatch
exercises.how: One explosive pull from the floor to overhead. A simpler snatch for power.
exercises.safe: Hips drive the dumbbell up, arm guides it close to the body. Punch up to lock out; don't swing it out wide.
exercises.fix: Extend the hips first, the arms finish last

exercises.name: Jump squat
exercises.how: Light load or bodyweight, quarter dip and jump as high as you can. Land soft.

exercises.name: Dumbbell jump squat
exercises.how: Light dumbbells at your sides. Quarter dip and jump as high as you can, land soft, reset each rep.

exercises.name: Trap bar jump
exercises.how: Light trap bar (20-30% of your deadlift), jump straight up, reset each rep.
exercises.mistake: Using the back to lift the bar
exercises.fix: Push the floor away, back flat, hips and legs do the work

exercises.name: Speed bench press
exercises.how: About 50-60% load, lower under control, press as fast as possible.
exercises.safe: Light bar, fast but controlled: no bouncing off the chest.

exercises.name: Landmine push press
exercises.how: Dip and drive the bar up from the shoulder in one explosive push.
needs: landmine or barbell in a corner
exercises.safe: Stay tall and drive with the legs; press up and slightly forward, not across your face.
exercises.fix: Ribs down, glutes tight, press straight up

exercises.name: Landmine rotational press
exercises.how: Bar end at your shoulder, side-on. Load the back hip, then turn the hips and punch the bar up and across in one move, like striking a ball.
needs: landmine or barbell in a corner
exercises.mistake: Twisting the lower back to move the bar
exercises.fix: Brace the trunk, move from the hips and shoulders

exercises.name: Landmine rotation
exercises.how: Arms long, bar end above your head. Turn it down to one hip, then the other, in a rainbow, hips leading and feet turning with it, arms straight. Once it's smooth, make it fast and powerful.
needs: landmine or barbell in a corner
exercises.fix: Turn from the hips and trunk, arms stay long

exercises.name: Med ball chest pass
exercises.how: Throw hard into a wall from the chest, catch and go again. Upper-body speed.
exercises.fix: Power from the hips: turn and throw through the ball

exercises.name: Med ball slam
exercises.how: Reach tall, slam the ball into the floor with everything.
exercises.fix: Power from the hips: turn and throw through the ball

exercises.name: Depth jump
exercises.how: Step off a low box, touch the floor and jump straight up instantly. Short ground contact.
exercises.safe: Step off, don't jump off. Land and leave the floor fast; if you sink deep or land loud, the box is too high.
exercises.mistake: Stepping off then dropping into a deep squat
exercises.fix: Contact the floor briefly and spring straight up

exercises.name: Depth jump over hurdle
exercises.how: Advanced depth jump. Step off a box, land on both feet and jump straight over a hurdle in front. Short ground contact: master the depth jump first.
exercises.safe: Advanced: only once normal depth jumps are easy. Low box and low hurdle first.
exercises.mistake: Stepping off then dropping into a deep squat
exercises.fix: Contact the floor briefly and spring straight up

exercises.name: Split-stance step-up jump
exercises.how: Front foot on a low step or plate, back foot on the floor: the same stance as the split-stance quarter squat. Dip and jump as high as you can, land back in the stance.
exercises.mistake: Landing stiff with the knees caving
exercises.fix: Land soft and quiet, knees over the toes

exercises.name: Single-leg RDL to box jump
exercises.how: Bodyweight single-leg RDL, snap the free knee forward and up, and jump onto the box off the standing foot. Land soft on both feet, step down.
exercises.mistake: Landing stiff with the knees caving
exercises.fix: Land soft and quiet, knees over the toes

exercises.name: Skater snap to box jump
exercises.how: Skate onto the left foot, snap across to the right, snap straight back, then jump onto the box at once. Fast feet, short contacts.
exercises.mistake: Landing stiff with the knees caving
exercises.fix: Land soft and quiet, knees over the toes

exercises.name: Pogo hops
exercises.how: Stiff ankles, bounce off the balls of the feet. Quick and springy.

exercises.name: Hurdle hops
exercises.how: Hop over low hurdles in a row, minimal time on the ground.
exercises.fix: Stiff ankles, quick off the ground

exercises.name: Lateral bounds (skaters)
exercises.how: Bound sideways off one leg, stick the landing for a second. Cutting power.
exercises.mistake: Landing stiff with the knees caving
exercises.fix: Land soft and quiet, knees over the toes

exercises.name: Countermovement jump
exercises.how: Quick dip, swing the arms, jump for max height. Test-day jump too.

exercises.name: Plyometric push-up
exercises.how: Push the floor away hard enough that your hands leave the ground.

exercises.name: Acceleration sprints 10-20 m
exercises.how: Full speed from a standing start on the track or turf. Full rest: quality over fatigue.
exercises.fix: Stay low and drive the knees for the first steps

exercises.name: Flying 20 m sprints
exercises.how: Build up over 20 m, then hit top speed for 20 m.
exercises.fix: Stay tall and relaxed, quick light feet

exercises.name: Resisted sprint (sled or band)
exercises.how: Light sled or band, drive the knees, lean forward. First-step power.
exercises.fix: Stay low and drive the knees for the first steps

exercises.name: Half squat
exercises.how: Heavier than your full squat, down to thighs about 45 degrees. Strength in the range you sprint and jump.
exercises.safe: Heavy and short range: stay braced and stop at half depth with control, never drop into it.

exercises.name: Quarter squat
exercises.how: Heavy, short dip, drive up fast. Use safety bars.
exercises.safe: Very heavy loads: use safety bars, stay braced, and keep the knees over the toes.
exercises.fix: Knees track the toes, heels flat, chest up

exercises.name: Landmine squat
exercises.how: Hold the end of the bar at your chest with both hands, feet a little wider than hips. Sit down between your hips, chest up, then drive up. Easy on the back.
needs: landmine or barbell in a corner
exercises.safe: Keep your chest up into the bar and your knees out; the bar end stays at your chest.

exercises.name: Split-stance quarter squat
exercises.how: Bar on your back, feet staggered: front foot flat, back heel up. Quarter-squat depth, then drive up fast. The front leg does the work.
exercises.safe: Bar on your back, feet hip-width apart in the split, not on one line. Front knee tracks over the toes.
exercises.fix: Knees track the toes, heels flat, chest up

exercises.name: Front squat
exercises.how: Elbows high, chest up, sit between the hips.
exercises.safe: Elbows high so the bar sits on your shoulders, not your wrists. Stay tall: if the elbows drop, the back rounds.

exercises.name: Barbell hip thrust
exercises.how: Shoulders on a bench, knees at 90 degrees at the top. Drive the hips up, hold a second and squeeze the glutes, lower slowly. Sprint power.
exercises.safe: Chin tucked and ribs down; finish with the glutes, not by arching your lower back. Pad the bar.

exercises.name: Conventional deadlift
exercises.how: Bar over mid-foot, flat back, push the floor away.
exercises.safe: Bar over the middle of your feet, flat back, push the floor away. Never jerk the bar off the floor or round your back to finish a rep.

exercises.name: Single-leg Romanian deadlift
exercises.how: Hinge on one leg, reach the other leg back, hips square. Balance and hamstrings.
exercises.safe: Go light until your balance is solid. Hips square, flat back, standing knee soft.

exercises.name: Single-leg RDL clean
exercises.how: Light barbell. Hinge on one leg, then drive up fast and bring the free knee forward and up, like the pull of a clean. Finish tall on the standing leg.
exercises.safe: Light bar only. Hinge with a flat back, then drive up tall; don't pull with your arms or lean back at the top.
exercises.mistake: Hips opening or the standing knee wobbling
exercises.fix: Hips square, knee over the toes, slow down

exercises.name: Landmine diagonal reverse lunge
exercises.how: Hold the end of the bar at your shoulder with both hands. Step back on a diagonal behind the front leg, lean into the bar, drive back up through the front foot.
needs: landmine or barbell in a corner
exercises.fix: Knee over the middle toe, torso tall

exercises.name: Landmine single-leg RDL
exercises.how: Bar end in the hand opposite the standing leg. Hinge on one leg, the free leg reaching back, hips square. The bar guides you, so you can load it heavier.
needs: landmine or barbell in a corner
exercises.mistake: Hips opening or the standing knee wobbling
exercises.fix: Hips square, knee over the toes, slow down

exercises.name: Landmine lateral lunge
exercises.how: Bar end at your chest. Step wide to the side and sit into that hip, the other leg long, then push back to the middle. Groin and side-to-side strength.
needs: landmine or barbell in a corner
exercises.fix: Knee over the middle toe, torso tall

exercises.name: Step-up (knee drive)
exercises.how: Box at knee height, drive up through the front leg, finish with a knee drive. Sprinter version: a lower step, fast and explosive.
exercises.safe: Drive through the front foot, don't spring off the back one. Box no higher than your knee.

exercises.name: Skater squat
exercises.how: Single-leg squat, back knee touches a pad behind you. Control on the way down.
exercises.mistake: Hips opening or the standing knee wobbling
exercises.fix: Hips square, knee over the toes, slow down

exercises.name: Single-arm dumbbell bench press
exercises.how: One dumbbell, resist the twist through your trunk.
exercises.fix: Elbows about 45 degrees, wrists stacked over elbows

exercises.name: Single-arm dumbbell row
exercises.how: Hand on a bench, pull to the hip, no twisting.
exercises.fix: Flat back, shoulders down, pull the elbows back

exercises.name: Isometric split squat hold
exercises.how: Hold the bottom of a split squat, front thigh parallel. Knee and tendon strength.

exercises.name: Wall sit
exercises.how: Back flat on the wall, thighs parallel to the floor.
exercises.mistake: Holding your breath and shaking out of position
exercises.fix: Breathe steadily, stop the set when the shape goes

exercises.name: Isometric mid-thigh pull
exercises.how: Bar fixed at mid-thigh (or pinned in a rack), pull as hard as you can for 5 seconds.
exercises.fix: Build the force smoothly over a second or two

exercises.name: Isometric long-lever bridge
exercises.how: Heels on a bench, legs nearly straight, lift the hips and hold. Harder: one leg at a time, 20 s each. Hamstring protection.
exercises.mistake: Arching the lower back at the top
exercises.fix: Ribs down, squeeze the glutes, stop at a straight line

exercises.name: Home warm-up: march, mobility, activation
exercises.how: March on the spot, arm circles, leg swings holding a wall, 10 glute bridges, 10 slow squats. Get warm before anything fast.
exercises.mistake: Rushing the warm-up at full speed
exercises.fix: Start easy, build up, stop if anything pinches

exercises.name: Tempo bodyweight squat
exercises.how: 3 seconds down, pause at the bottom, drive up fast. Too easy? Hold a backpack full of books.

exercises.name: Reverse lunge
exercises.how: Step back, back knee just above the floor, push through the front heel. Stay tall.
exercises.fix: Knee over the middle toe, torso tall

exercises.name: Split squat, back foot on the sofa
exercises.how: Bulgarian split squat at home: back foot on the sofa or a chair, slow down, strong up.
exercises.fix: Knee over the middle toe, torso tall

exercises.name: Single-leg glute bridge
exercises.how: Shoulders on the floor, one foot planted, drive the hips up and squeeze for a second at the top.
exercises.mistake: Arching the lower back at the top
exercises.fix: Ribs down, squeeze the glutes, stop at a straight line

exercises.name: Hamstring slider curl (towel)
exercises.how: On a smooth floor, heels on a towel: bridge up, slide the heels out slowly, pull them back in. Hamstring insurance.
exercises.mistake: Arching the lower back at the top
exercises.fix: Ribs down, squeeze the glutes, stop at a straight line

exercises.name: Cossack squat
exercises.how: Wide stance, sit into one hip with the other leg straight, toes up. Good for groins and hips.
exercises.fix: Knee over the middle toe, torso tall

exercises.name: Wall sit hold
exercises.how: Back flat on a wall, thighs parallel to the floor. Breathe and hold.
exercises.mistake: Holding your breath and shaking out of position
exercises.fix: Breathe steadily, stop the set when the shape goes

exercises.name: Squat jump
exercises.how: Quick dip and jump as high as you can. Land soft and quiet, reset, then go again.

exercises.name: Skater hops
exercises.how: Jump sideways from one leg to the other, stick each landing for a second.
exercises.mistake: Landing stiff with the knees caving
exercises.fix: Land soft and quiet, knees over the toes

exercises.name: Split jumps
exercises.how: From a lunge, jump and switch legs in the air. Land soft, stay balanced.
exercises.mistake: Landing stiff with the knees caving
exercises.fix: Land soft and quiet, knees over the toes

exercises.name: Tempo push-up
exercises.how: 2 seconds down, chest to the floor, push up fast. Knees down if the form goes.

exercises.name: Pike push-up
exercises.how: Hips high in an upside-down V, lower the head towards the floor, press back up. Shoulders.
exercises.fix: Ribs down, glutes tight, press straight up

exercises.name: Table row
exercises.how: Lie under a sturdy table, grip the edge, pull your chest up to it with a straight body. Back and arms.
exercises.fix: Flat back, shoulders down, pull the elbows back

exercises.name: Chair dips
exercises.how: Hands on the edge of a chair, lower until the elbows are at 90 degrees, press up.
exercises.fix: Ribs down, glutes tight, press straight up

exercises.name: Plank with shoulder taps
exercises.how: High plank, feet wide, tap the opposite shoulder without the hips rocking.
exercises.fix: Wide feet, squeeze the glutes, move only the arm

exercises.name: Side plank
exercises.how: Elbow under the shoulder, body in a straight line. Hips up the whole time.
exercises.fix: Squeeze the glutes, one line from head to heels

exercises.name: Hollow hold
exercises.how: Lower back pressed into the floor, arms and legs long and just off the ground.
exercises.fix: Squeeze the glutes, one line from head to heels

exercises.name: Copenhagen plank on the sofa
exercises.how: Side plank with the top leg on the sofa, bottom leg hanging. Groin strength for footballers.
exercises.fix: Squeeze the glutes, one line from head to heels

exercises.name: Burpee intervals
exercises.how: Steady rhythm for the whole interval, not a sprint and a stop.
exercises.mistake: Sagging in the lower back on the floor
exercises.fix: Brace, chest down, step or jump back with control

exercises.name: High knees + fast feet
exercises.how: 10 seconds high knees, 10 seconds fast feet on the spot, repeat. Arms working.
exercises.fix: Stay on the balls of the feet with stiff ankles

exercises.name: Toe taps and sole rolls
exercises.how: Alternate toe taps on top of the ball, then roll it side to side under the sole. Light and quick.
exercises.fix: Head up between touches, glance down only to check

exercises.name: V-pulls and inside-outside
exercises.how: Pull the ball back with the sole and push it away with the inside of the same foot, both feet. Small space is fine.
exercises.fix: Soft touches, ball always within a stride

exercises.name: Keepy-uppy, weak foot only
exercises.how: Weak foot only, count your best streak. Low touches, ankle locked.
exercises.fix: Soft touches, ball always within a stride

exercises.name: Wall passes, one touch (small space)
exercises.how: Close to a wall, one-touch passes with the inside of both feet. Soft ankle to control.
exercises.mistake: Stabbing at the ball with a stiff foot
exercises.fix: Soft ankle, cushion it, open your body to the pass

exercises.name: Home cool-down: floor stretch
exercises.how: Hip flexor stretch, hamstring stretch, figure-4 glute, child's pose. Slow breathing.
exercises.fix: Ease in, hold still and breathe

exercises.name: Half-kneeling landmine press
exercises.how: Kneel on the knee on the same side as the pressing arm, front foot flat, glute of the down knee squeezed. Press along the line of the bar and lean slightly into it, up and forward until the arm is long. Don't press back or lean away.
needs: landmine or barbell in a corner
exercises.fix: Ribs down, glutes tight, press straight up

exercises.name: Landmine single-arm row
exercises.how: Split stance beside the end of the bar, free hand on the front knee, back flat. Pull the bar end to your hip, pause, lower slowly. Don't twist open.
needs: landmine or barbell in a corner
exercises.fix: Flat back, shoulders down, pull the elbows back

exercises.name: Lateral step-up (knee drive)
exercises.how: Stand side-on to a box, kettlebell at your chest. Near foot on the box, drive up through it and finish with the other knee high. Step down slowly.
exercises.fix: Drive through the front leg, back foot just touches

exercises.name: Kneeling jump to box jump
exercises.how: Start tall on both knees. Swing your arms and pop up onto your feet in a squat, then jump straight onto the box. Land soft, step down, reset.
exercises.mistake: Jumping up then falling off the back
exercises.fix: Land softly on the whole foot, then step down

exercises.name: Wall drive (acceleration march)
exercises.how: Hands on a wall, body in one straight line at about 45 degrees, up on the balls of your feet. Drive one knee up hard, then switch. Hips stay high and the line doesn't break: the same angle as the first steps of a sprint.
exercises.fix: Stay low and drive the knees for the first steps

exercises.name: Half-kneeling kettlebell halo
exercises.how: Half-kneeling, hold a kettlebell upside down by the handle at your chest. Circle it close around your head, then the other way. Ribs down, glutes tight, don't lean.
exercises.mistake: Leaning back and flaring the ribs
exercises.fix: Ribs down, glutes tight, keep the bell close

exercises.name: Stir the pot
exercises.how: Forearms on a stability ball, feet wide, body in a plank. Draw small circles with your forearms without letting your hips sag or twist.
exercises.fix: Wide feet, squeeze the glutes, move only the arm

exercises.name: Single-leg lateral rebounds
exercises.how: On one leg beside a line or a low box. Hop sideways over it and straight back, as quick and springy as you can. Short ground contact, knee over the toes.
exercises.fix: Stiff ankles, quick off the ground

exercises.name: Toe-down wall strikes
exercises.how: Stand close to a wall. Strike the ball into it with your toe pointing straight down and the ankle locked, contact on the laces. Small, firm strikes: the locked ankle is what puts power in a shot.
exercises.mistake: Planting too far from the ball, shot sails over
exercises.fix: Plant beside the ball, knee over it, follow through low

exercises.name: Wall passes: number call
exercises.how: Pass against a wall. The app calls a number as the ball comes back: even, pass it straight back first time; odd, take a touch to turn and drive away. Scan, listen, react.
exercises.mistake: Stabbing at the ball with a stiff foot
exercises.fix: Soft ankle, cushion it, open your body to the pass

exercises.name: Bulgarian split squat jump
exercises.how: Back foot on a low bench, front foot forward as in a Bulgarian split squat. Drop into it, then jump as high as you can off the front leg and land softly back in the same stance.
exercises.mistake: Landing stiff with the knees caving
exercises.fix: Land soft and quiet, knees over the toes

exercises.name: Broad jump to cut
exercises.how: Broad jump forward and land soft on both feet, then straight away plant and cut 45 degrees into a 5 m sprint. Alternate the side you cut to.
exercises.mistake: Landing stiff with the knees caving
exercises.fix: Land soft and quiet, knees over the toes

exercises.name: Box toe taps
exercises.how: Stand in front of a low box or step. Tap the top with one foot then the other, as fast as you can, up on the balls of your feet. Arms pump like sprinting.
exercises.fix: Stiff ankles, quick off the ground

exercises.name: Seated box jump
exercises.how: Sit on a bench, feet flat, a box in front. Swing your arms and jump from seated straight onto the box, landing soft. No rocking: it trains starting strength from a dead stop.
exercises.mistake: Jumping up then falling off the back
exercises.fix: Land softly on the whole foot, then step down

exercises.name: Single-leg box jump
exercises.how: On one leg in front of a low box. Swing your arms and jump onto the box off that leg, landing on the same leg, soft and balanced. Step down; don't jump down.
exercises.mistake: Jumping up then falling off the back
exercises.fix: Land softly on the whole foot, then step down

exercises.name: Copenhagen plank (short lever)
exercises.how: Side plank on your forearm with the top knee on a bench and the bottom knee bent under you. Lift the hips into a straight line and hold. The first step before the full Copenhagen.
exercises.fix: Squeeze the glutes, one line from head to heels

exercises.name: Falling starts
exercises.how: Stand tall on the balls of your feet. Lean forward as one stiff line until you're about to fall, then sprint out with short, powerful steps for 10 m. Teaches the acceleration angle.
exercises.fix: Stay low and drive the knees for the first steps

exercises.name: Get-up sprints
exercises.how: Lie face down, hands by your chest. Push up, get your feet under you as fast as you can and sprint 10 m. Reaction and first steps from an awkward start, like getting up after a tackle.
exercises.fix: Stay low and drive the knees for the first steps

exercises.name: Ankling
exercises.how: Small, quick steps forward with stiff ankles: the ball of the foot hits the ground just under the hips and pops off. Tall posture, relaxed arms. Sprint rhythm before the fast work.
exercises.fix: Stay on the balls of the feet with stiff ankles

exercises.name: 5-10-5 shuttle
exercises.how: Three markers 5 m apart in a line, start at the middle one. Sprint 5 m to one side, touch the line, 10 m to the far marker, touch, then 5 m back through the middle. Stay low into every turn.
exercises.fix: Plant the outside foot hard and push off it

exercises.name: Backpedal to hip turn
exercises.how: Backpedal with short steps, chest over your toes. Open your hips 45 degrees, crossover step and sprint away. Defending: this is how you turn and run with an attacker.
exercises.fix: Chest over the toes, short steps, turn the hips early

exercises.name: Ab wheel rollout
exercises.how: Kneel holding an ab wheel (or a barbell with plates) under your shoulders. Roll forward slowly as far as you can without your lower back sagging, then pull back with your abs. Ribs down the whole time.
exercises.mistake: Lower back sagging as you roll out
exercises.fix: Squeeze the glutes, ribs down, go only as far as you can hold

exercises.name: Side plank thread the needle
exercises.how: Side plank on your forearm, top arm to the ceiling. Reach it under your body, turning the chest to the floor, then open back up tall. Hips stay high the whole time.
exercises.fix: Wide feet, squeeze the glutes, move only the arm

exercises.name: Standing hip CARs
exercises.how: Stand tall holding a post. Lift one knee up, open it out to the side, turn it round behind you and bring it down: the biggest slow circle you can make without the trunk moving. Then reverse.
exercises.fix: Slow and controlled, feel it in the hip

exercises.name: Banded hip-flexor march
exercises.how: Mini band round both feet, stand tall holding a post. Drive one knee up to hip height against the band, hold 2 seconds, lower slowly. Strong hip flexors for sprinting.
exercises.fix: Slow and controlled, feel it in the hip

exercises.name: Med ball rotational slam
exercises.how: Ball overhead, turn and slam it hard into the floor beside your outside foot, pivoting the back foot. Pick it up and go to the other side. The power comes from the hips.
exercises.fix: Power from the hips: turn and throw through the ball

exercises.name: Landmine squat to press
exercises.how: End of the bar at your chest in both hands. Squat down, then drive up and press the bar up and forward in one move, finishing on your toes. The legs start it, the arms finish it.
needs: landmine or barbell in a corner
exercises.safe: Brace before you drive; press along the bar's line, not back over your head.
exercises.fix: Ribs down, glutes tight, press straight up

templates.title: Close control & 1v1
templates.summary: Tight-space control, direction changes with the ball, 1v1 reactions with voice cues, finish.

templates.title: Wall passing, weak foot & shooting
templates.summary: First touch off the wall (ground and air), left-foot work, shooting still and moving, crossing.

items.how: Easy jog, leg swings, high knees, butt kicks, side shuffles.
Sprint 10 m, plant, cut, accelerate 5 m. Alternate the cutting foot. Stop if you feel sharp knee pain.
Hip flexor, quad, hamstring, figure-4 glute stretch, 60 s each side.

templates.title: With a partner: one- and two-touch
templates.summary: One- and two-touch passing on the ground and in the air, then 1v1s.

items.how: Easy jog together, leg swings, lunges with a twist.

templates.title: Recovery: hips, quads, hamstrings
templates.summary: No ball. Loosen the hips and strengthen around the IT band.

templates.title: Gym: lower body + power
templates.summary: Jumps first while fresh, then heavy legs and hamstring protection.

templates.title: Gym: upper body + core
templates.summary: Upper strength and a strong trunk for holding off defenders. Supersets pair a push with a pull: do one, go straight into the other, then rest.

templates.title: Gym: full body (game week)
templates.summary: Lighter full-body session for weeks with games: fewer sets, nothing that leaves your legs heavy.

templates.title: Gym: explosive power
templates.summary: Olympic lift, jumps and sprints first while fresh, then a heavy short-range lift.

templates.title: Gym: single leg + isometrics
templates.summary: Single-leg strength and tendon holds: balance, cutting and injury protection.

templates.title: Gym: contrast lifts
templates.summary: Heavy set, then straight into a light explosive set of the same movement. The heavy lift wakes the muscles up so the jump is faster. Rest fully between rounds.

templates.title: Gym: explosive lower body
templates.summary: Contrast pairs: a heavy-ish lift, then the explosive version of the same movement straight after. Split stance, single leg and lateral, like the game. Rest fully between rounds.

templates.title: Hybrid: light legs + close control
templates.summary: For MD+2 or a day you have the gym and a pitch: light explosive lower body, then out to the field for tight-space control.

templates.title: Home: legs + power (no gym)
templates.summary: No gym, no problem: jumps first while fresh, then single-leg strength with the sofa, a towel and a wall.

templates.title: Home: upper body + core
templates.summary: Push and pull with a table and a chair, then core. Supersets keep it short.

templates.title: Home: full body, short (game week)
templates.summary: A short full-body session for game weeks or busy days: a bit of power, a bit of strength, nothing that leaves the legs heavy.

templates.title: Home: ball in a small space
templates.summary: Touches in the living room, garage or garden: sole work, weak foot and one-touch on a wall, then a quick burn.

templates.title: Gym: upper body power (submax)
templates.summary: MD-2: upper body strength without grinding (stop 2-3 reps short), plus fast throws and presses. Legs stay fresh for the game.

items.how: Submax: a weight you could do 2-3 more reps with. Controlled down, drive up fast.

templates.title: Gym: core & injury prevention
templates.summary: MD-3: the work that keeps you on the pitch. Hamstrings (Nordics), groin (Copenhagen), rotational core and single-leg control.

templates.title: Gym: match-eve activation
templates.summary: MD-1: about 25 minutes. Short maximal isometric holds and a few fast jumps wake the nervous system up without tiring the legs. Leave feeling sharp, not tired.

templates.title: Speed: acceleration and agility
templates.summary: Rhythm drills, then jumps for distance, then sprint starts and cuts. Fully rested reps: quality over quantity.
